clan_loot_shares_remaining_check.name: clan_loot_shares_remaining_check
clan_loot_shares_remaining_check.value:
"clan_loot_shares"."remaining_alloy" BETWEEN 0 AND "clan_loot_shares"."alloy"
      AND "clan_loot_shares"."remaining_crystal" BETWEEN 0 AND "clan_loot_shares"."crystal"
      AND "clan_loot_shares"."remaining_deuterium" BETWEEN 0 AND "clan_loot_shares"."deuterium"

mining_one_target.name: mining_one_target
mining_one_target.value:
(asteroid_index is not null and debris_field_id is null)
     or (asteroid_index is null and debris_field_id is not null)

planets_controller_kind_check.name: planets_controller_kind_check
planets_controller_kind_check.value:
("planets"."kind" = 'NEUTRAL' AND "planets"."player_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("planets"."kind" <> 'NEUTRAL' AND "planets"."player_id" IS NOT NULL)
